records.artist: Various authors.
records.creditLine:
• Việt Nam Hồn. - April 29, 2012 / leminhkhai. - I haven’t had much time recently to post anything new here. I’m still busy, but I thought I would post a document which some people might find interesting.. (Lê Minh Khải's SEAsian History Blog).
  • It’s a page from a newspaper from the 1920s called the Soul of Việt Nam (Vietnamese: Việt Nam Hồn). It appears to have been registered in France, and it looks to me like that is where it was published, as I don’t think one could publish articles in French Indochina at the time which directly called for independence, like the articles in this paper did.. (Lê Minh Khải's SEAsian History Blog).
